# React Bits sources

Fetched from the official public registry on 2026-10-20 using the installed React Bits skill:

- https://reactbits.dev/r/Folder-TS-CSS.json

Local adaptation: Folder treats an explicitly supplied empty items array as empty instead of
showing the upstream demonstration documents. Other vendor source remains as fetched.
The application uses the solid folder variant (no WebGL), controlled selection and motion settings.
